description: The knowledge graph over a record's documents, assembled for reasoning rather than listed. Scope with entity + entity_id (everything filed on one lead/job/contact) or document_ids. Returns the facts grouped by concept, each with its VERBATIM quote and its source document, plus four things worked out in code rather than guessed: `bridges` (concepts appearing in more than one document — the connections a person would otherwise have to make by reading both), `contradictions` (a concept carrying both a statement and its negation), `negations`, and `from_ocr` (facts whose quote came out of image recognition, where a number can be misread). Optional: concept (only this one), limit. Read-only. Use analyze_graph instead if you want the reading done server-side.

concept.description: Only facts whose concept contains this text

entity.description: Record type whose documents form the graph (e.g. lead, job, contact); use with entity_id

include_facts.description: false = nur Zaehlungen und Auffaelligkeiten, ohne die Faktenliste.

name: get_graph
